footer.statement: You Want To Learn About Me?

home.bio: For me, the IT industry has never been easy, and money does not simply come in as a windfall. There have been times when I had to choose between my personal life and my work. But in the end, I will try my best.
home.ouhcmc: Ho Chi Minh City Open University
home.quote: I want AI to help me pursue my dreams and passions, not to take those dreams away from me.

worldview.title: My World View
worldview.p1_desc: Based on the MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator), I am an INFP (Introversion, Intuition, Feeling, and Perception). I tend to be extremely persistent when I work, while I think I am quite normal in other areas.
worldview.p2_desc: I am currently affected by Parkinson's Law and I am not very good at organizing my work. Even though I can work from 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM, I never feel that I have done enough for a project. So, I am trying to find a different way of working that will suit me better in the future.
worldview.p3_desc: To be honest, I entered the IT industry mainly because it was a popular and promising field. At the moment, I think my projects and work are still quite good, and I am also interested in them. However, I have noticed one problem: there is often a trade-off between working efficiently and gaining knowledge.
worldview.p4_desc: I think AI is quite scary for three reasons: automation, higher productivity, and less thinking. These tools seem to be made for people with strong knowledge. If your knowledge is good enough, AI can help you more safely. On the other hand, if you do not have enough knowledge, AI may cause problems for you.
worldview.p5_desc: Think about your interests and the career you want from the beginning. Because of AI, every field can have good opportunities if you know how to use AI in your own work. I recommend avoiding careers just because they are popular or trending at the moment.

developer.summary_subtitle: A third-year student aiming to become a software engineer
developer.summary_bio: Hello everyone, my name is Van Trung Thanh, and I am a student at Ho Chi Minh City Open University. I study Information Technology, with a focus on software engineering. I am also interested in training and developing AI models. Although I can easily get tired from work, I always try to stay persistent and complete my work well.
developer.card_01_desc: Designing software architecture, following the SDLC, and analysing system requirements.
developer.card_02_desc: Building AI Agent systems for tasks such as RAG and LLM-based coding.
developer.card_03_desc: Automating SAST/DAST testing, finding some problems through automated testing, and deploying systems.
developer.card_04_desc: A feature is only truly good when it has been developed and tested many times.
developer.hobbies_sub: Sources of inspiration outside of coding
developer.hobby_subculture_desc: One character who inspires me is Subaru from Re:Zero. I also enjoy other anime such as EIGHTY-SIX and Youjo Senki.
developer.hobby_ai_desc: I hope to find ways to help people use AI in a useful and meaningful way, without becoming too dependent on it.
developer.hobby_learning_desc: Top 5 songs I like: Hated By Life Itself (Kanzaki Lori), Birds of a Feather (Billie Eilish), The Other Side Of Paradise (Glass Animals), Imposter Syndrome (Sidney Gish), Let It Happen (Tame Impala)
developer.milestone_1_desc: I joined the K23 course at Ho Chi Minh City Open University, majoring in Information Technology. As of August 2026, I am a third-year student and preparing for my internship.
developer.milestone_2_desc: I learned how an LLM works, common types of AI models, and how to train and evaluate them for the first time. At the end of the course, I received a certificate from SIC (Samsung Innovation Campus).
developer.milestone_3_desc: During this semester, I learned two important skills: software architecture and software testing. These skills helped me better understand and apply the SDLC process.
developer.milestone_4_desc: During this period, I explored, researched, and developed applications that use AI technologies such as RAG and hybrid retrieval. I also became interested in vibe coding and agentic coding.
developer.skills_disclaimer: Note: The skills shown here represent about 80% of what I know and have used. They do not represent 100% of my theoretical or practical knowledge.
